legal_units.title: Charge of tax in case of a firm.
legal_units.text: In the case of a firm which is assessable as a firm, tax shall be charged on its total income at the rate as specified in any Central Act for relevant tax year.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 324 Charge of tax in case of a firm. In the case of a firm which is assessable as a firm, tax shall be charged on its total income at the rate as specified in any Central Act for relevant tax year.
